Snapchat groups—unlike WhatsApp groups that leave control on admin—are somewhat free because anyone in the group can add new members. If you are in a situation where someone in the group starts to be noisy or annoying, it becomes essential to learn how to remove someone from Snapchat group.

Can I Remove Someone from Snapchat Group?

Unfortunately, Snapchat doesn’t have a feature that enables you to kick someone out of a group. This means it is impossible to directly remove a person from a Snapchat group. Once they join, they will be in forever unless they leave the group or the group is dismissed.

Depending on the person, this can cause a problem in your group. It may lead to endless issues or arguments, especially if the person has a different perspective. The good news is that there’s a couple of alternatives that allow you to get rid of someone you don’t like in the group.

Despite there is no built-in feature to remove someone from a group, there are several ways to overcome this issue. With these alternatives, other group members and you can enjoy using the Snapchat group with peace of mind.

PrintPhoto Books

Alternatives to Remove Someone from Snapchat Group

There are four alternatives to get rid of annoying person in your Snapchat group. But please note these alternatives are not 100 percent effective. If you have tried all of the alternatives below but none of them work, you might need to consider using platforms with a better group control.

Here is a complete list of alternative to remove someone from your Snapchat group:

1. Ask the Person to Leave

It may sound a little bit rude and aggressive but this is the best option to clean your group from unwanted person. You can ask the person in question to leave the group in the first place. Once they leave, their chats and snaps will disappear from the group.

HostForums

But if you are not comfortable with the situation, can’t find the right words, or you believe that it may cause serious problems, you will need to find another way. Jump to the next alternative below.

2. Create a New Group

Depending on other members, you can make a deal to create a new group. This is possibly the best alternative especially if you have something urgent to discuss. When you set up a new group, be sure the person you wish to remove doesn’t know anything about it. Learn how to create a new group below.

GetWriting Tools

3. Leave the Group

If you have tried to ask the person to leave but they remain in, leaving the group can be a good alternative. It is much better to leave the conversation rather than getting around with someone you don’t like. Just make sure it is not an important group so you don’t miss important information.

How to Create a New Snapchat Group

One of ways to remove someone from a group is by creating a new group. Fortunately, setting up a new group on Snapchat is completely easy. It only takes a few minutes with a few simple steps. Once you create a new group, you can send Snaps and chats to discuss on specific things.

Here is how to remove someone from Snapchat group by setting up a new one:

  • Launch the Snapchat app.
  • Tap the chat bubble icon on the lower left of the screen to go to Friends screen.
  • Tap the New Chat icon in the upper-right corner of your screen.
  • Select New Group option.
  • Go through the list of your friends. To add friends to the group, simply tap on their names.
  • When you’re done choosing friends, select Chat with Group.

Now your group is already created. You can interact with other members, such as sending Snap, chats, or even play games.

How to Add Friends to Snapchat Group

Let’s say that you just missed a few friends and want to add them to the group. Or you have new friends and want them to join the crowd. This platform allows you to add new users and it supports up to 32 members. Adding friends to the group is completely simple and easy.

Follow step by step instructions below:

  • Launch the Snapchat app on your phone’s home screen.
  • Go to Friends screen, tap and hold the group you want to add the person.
  • Tap More then select Add Members to Group.
  • From the friends list, choose friends you want to add to the group.

Be careful when choosing friends to join the group. The fact that Snapchat group doesn’t have remove feature means they will stick around forever. So make sure the friends you chose won’t mess up with the group or you have to do several alternatives above.

How to Leave a Snapchat Group

For whatever reasons, you can always leave a group on Snapchat. When you leave a group, Snap and chats you sent will be automatically deleted from the conversation. This action is irreversible, which means you won’t be able to access the chats once you exit.

PrintPhoto Books

If you are determined to leave a group, here are steps to do:

  • Open your Snapchat app and navigate to Friends screen.
  • Tap and hold the group you want to leave.
  • Select More then tap Leave Group.
  • On a confirmation popup, affirm that you want to leave the group chat.

Rather than leaving the group and losing all your messages, you might need to try another alternative. Opt to silent message notification so the group will not bother you. By doing this, you remain in the group without receiving alerts repeatedly.
